messages.content: "Can you help me plan a dinner? I am looking for a vegan main course recipe that can be prepared within 45 minutes. After dinner, we are planning to play a poker game, could you tell me the probability of getting a full house with a deck of 52 cards and a hand size of 5? Also, I am new to Denver, CO and would like to know the nearby hospitals within a radius of 10 kms, specifically those with an Emergency department."

function.name: find_recipe
function.description: Find a recipe based on the dietary restrictions, recipe type, and time constraints. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

dietary_restrictions.description: Dietary restrictions e.g. vegan, vegetarian, gluten free, dairy free.

recipe_type.description: Type of the recipe. E.g. dessert, main course, breakfast.

time.description: Time limit in minutes to prep the meal.

function.name: poker_probability_full_house
function.description: Calculate the probability of getting a full house in a poker game. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

deck_size.description: The size of the deck. Default is 52.

hand_size.description: The size of the hand. Default is 5.

function.name: hospital_locate
function.description: Locate nearby hospitals based on location and radius. Options to include specific departments are available. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The city and state, e.g. Denver, CO

radius.description: The radius within which you want to find the hospital in kms.

department.description: Specific department within the hospital. Default to none if not provided.

message.reasoning: The user wants multiple pieces of information: a recipe, poker probability, and hospital locations. We have three tools: find_recipe, poker_probability_full_house, hospital_locate. We need to call each tool separately. The user wants a vegan main course within 45 minutes. Then probability of full house with deck 52, hand 5. Then hospitals in Denver, CO within 10 km with Emergency department. So we need to call find_recipe with dietary_restrictions="vegan", recipe_type="main course", time=45. Then call poker_probability_full_house with deck_size=52, hand_size=5. Then call hospital_locate with location="Denver, CO", radius=10, department="Emergency". We should do them in order. The user wants all three. We can call them sequentially. The user didn't specify any other constraints. So we will call find_recipe first.
